provenance.note: Data-only declaration locators; source controls, fields, actual calls and unknown ports are computed independently. Benchmark prose and source comments are not expected answers.

conditions: The selected captured declarations are active and the recorded source expressions are reached normally.
Recorded statement order is conditional on preceding asynchronous calls returning normally; opaque dependency effects and current object values remain unknown.
counterexamples: Missing input, missing projected records, read failures and callback activation remain distinct source branches.
The selected facade and projection source do not certify transitive purity, absence of effects in all dependencies, authorization, external I/O success or complete business semantics.
